# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # A callout for user attention. An icon placed as the first child sits in
  # its own grid column next to the title and description, like shadcn's Alert.
  # role="alert" makes screen readers announce it and interrupt the user. Pass
  # role: "status" to announce it politely, or role: nil for a static callout.
  # Variants mirror shadcn; pass class: for any other color.
  class Alert < Base
    VARIANTS = {
      default: "bg-card text-card-foreground",
      destructive: "text-destructive bg-card *:data-[slot=alert-description]:text-destructive/90 *:[svg]:text-current"
    }.freeze

    def initialize(variant: :default, **attrs)
      @variant = variant.to_s.to_sym
      @variant = :default unless VARIANTS.key?(@variant) # nil or unknown: default look

      super(**attrs) # must be called after variant is set
      # mix joins string attributes ("alert status") and ignores nil, so the
      # user's role replaces the default here, and nil removes it.
      if attrs.key?(:role)
        attrs[:role].nil? ? @attrs.delete(:role) : @attrs[:role] = attrs[:role]
      end
    end

    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "alert"},
        role: "alert",
        class: [
          "group/alert relative grid w-full gap-0.5 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-left text-sm",
          "has-data-[slot=alert-action]:relative has-data-[slot=alert-action]:pr-18",
          "has-[>svg]:grid-cols-[auto_1fr] has-[>svg]:gap-x-2.5",
          "*:[svg]:row-span-2 *:[svg]:translate-y-0.5 *:[svg]:text-current *:[svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4",
          VARIANTS.fetch(@variant)
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Top-right slot for a control (a button, a link). The Alert reserves right
  # padding for it when present.
  class AlertAction < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "alert-action"},
        class: "absolute top-2.5 right-3"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class AlertDescription < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "alert-description"},
        class: "text-muted-foreground text-sm text-balance md:text-pretty [&_p:not(:last-child)]:mb-4 [&_a]:underline [&_a]:underline-offset-3 [&_a]:hover:text-foreground"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class AlertTitle < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "alert-title"},
        class: "font-medium group-has-[>svg]/alert:col-start-2 [&_a]:underline [&_a]:underline-offset-3 [&_a]:hover:text-foreground"
      }
    end
  end
end

# Alert

Displays a callout for user attention.

## Usage

### Example

```ruby
Alert do
  info_icon
  AlertTitle { "Heads up!" }
  AlertDescription { "You can add components to your app using the CLI." }
end
```

### Without Icon

```ruby
Alert do
  AlertTitle { "Pro tip" }
  AlertDescription { "Simply, don't include an icon and your alert will look like this." }
end
```

### Destructive

```ruby
Alert(variant: :destructive) do
  circle_alert_icon
  AlertTitle { "Something went wrong" }
  AlertDescription { "Your session has expired. Please log in again." }
end
```

### Custom Colors

```ruby
Alert(class: "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-900 dark:border-amber-900 dark:bg-amber-950 dark:text-amber-50") do
  triangle_alert_icon
  AlertTitle { "Your subscription will expire in 3 days." }
  AlertDescription { "Renew now to avoid service interruption or upgrade to a paid plan to continue using the service." }
end
```

### With Action

```ruby
Alert do
  info_icon
  AlertTitle { "Dark mode is now available" }
  AlertDescription { "Enable it under your profile settings." }
  AlertAction do
    Button(variant: :outline, size: :sm) { "Enable" }
  end
end
```

### Static callout

```ruby
Alert(role: nil) do
  AlertTitle { "Pro tip" }
  AlertDescription { "With RubyUI you'll ship faster." }
end
```

### Title as a heading

```ruby
Alert(role: nil) do
  AlertTitle { h3 { "Billing" } }
  AlertDescription { "Your plan renews on the first day of each month." }
end
```
